Lakeview East Kidical Mass

Chicago, IL · Lakeview · Social

FamilyBeginner friendlyNo-drop

Lakeview East Kidical Mass is a social group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls last Saturday of the month at 9:15 am from Nettelhorst School, near the front playlot. About 2-4 miles, slow, 5-6 mph. No-drop.

For visitors

Rain or shine. Helmets required. Children ride with a parent or guardian and should be past training wheels; trail-a-bikes, trailers and child seats are welcome. Volunteer-led.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 5-6 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @nettelhorstbike the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lakeview East Kidical Mass group ride

A slow neighborhood ride for kids and their grown-ups: two to four miles at walking-to-jogging pace with stops. Each month has a theme; October's is a Halloween ride.
